questions.question: The Nobel Prizes were first awarded in:
questions.rationale: Alfred Nobel died in 1896; his will's prizes were first distributed on 5 December 1901, the fifth anniversary of his death.

questions.question: The Nobel Prize category that was NOT part of Nobel's original will is:
questions.rationale: The economics prize was endowed by Sweden's central bank in 1968 in Nobel's memory — the reason it is formally called a prize 'in economic sciences'.

questions.question: The first Indian Nobel laureate was:
questions.rationale: Tagore won the 1913 Literature Nobel — the first non-European laureate. Raman (1930) was the first Indian in the sciences.

questions.question: Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize?
questions.rationale: Marie Curie took the 1903 Physics Nobel — and later the 1911 Chemistry Nobel, making her the only person with Nobels in two different sciences.

questions.question: The first Indian-born winner of an Oscar was:
questions.rationale: Costume designer Bhanu Athaiya won for Richard Attenborough's Gandhi (1983). Satyajit Ray received an honorary Oscar in 1992.

questions.question: The Booker Prize is awarded for:
questions.rationale: Founded in 1969, it honours the best novel in English published in the UK — originally restricted to Commonwealth and Irish authors.

questions.question: 'Tomb of Sand', the first Hindi novel to win the International Booker, was written by:
questions.rationale: Geetanjali Shree's ret dahi gardbh ka ghar (translated by Daisy Rockwell) took the 2022 International Booker — the first Hindi work to do so.

questions.question: The Ramon Magsaysay Award, often called Asia's Nobel, is administered from:
questions.rationale: The award, instituted in 1958 after the Philippine president's death, is given from Manila. Vinoba Bhave was its first laureate.

questions.question: The Fields Medal, mathematics' most famous honour, can only be awarded to mathematicians:
questions.rationale: Awarded every four years to up to four mathematicians under 40, it is the age rule — not the medal itself — that the paper tests.

questions.question: Which Indian musician has won the most Grammy Awards?
questions.rationale: Pandit Ravi Shankar won five Grammys, including a lifetime-achievement award — the sitar maestro remains India's most-awarded musician at the Grammys.
